description: Configuration of the Fraxis REST gateway (stored in the database, not in site_config).

fields.label: Disable Gateway
fields.description: On: every gateway path falls through to Frappe (404). Frappe's own /api is never affected.

fields.label: Base Path
fields.description: URL prefix of every gateway route, e.g. /fraxis or /gw. Frappe's own prefixes (/api, /app, /assets, /files, /private, /login…) are not allowed.

fields.label: Docs Languages
fields.description: Language codes the API docs can be read in, one per line (the first is the default). Texts are translated with Frappe's translations, including the Translation DocType for route names.

fields.label: Authentication
fields.description: POST <base_path>/auth/token with the user's API Key and API Secret returns an access token and a refresh token; <base_path>/auth/refresh renews them and <base_path>/auth/revoke ends the session. Every other route only accepts Authorization: Bearer <access_token>.

fields.label: Refresh Token TTL (seconds)
fields.description: Sliding: every refresh returns a new refresh token with this lifetime and invalidates the old one.

fields.label: Token Signing Secret
fields.description: Generated automatically. Changing it invalidates every access token already issued.

fields.label: Exposed DocTypes
fields.description: Only routes whose DocType is exposed are served and listed in the API docs.

fields.label: Only Expose
fields.description: When set, exactly these DocTypes are exposed and the other exposure fields are disabled (they are cleared on save). Remove every row to use them again.

fields.label: Exposed Apps
fields.description: One app per line. Empty: every installed app except frappe.

fields.label: Also Expose
fields.description: Exposed in addition to the apps above (e.g. ToDo).

fields.label: Excluded Fields
fields.description: Fields the gateway never returns, filters, sorts or writes. Password fields are always excluded.

fields.label: Field Mappings
fields.description: Rename a field for clients (responses, filters, request bodies and the API docs) without renaming it in the DocType, and choose whether the docs show its description.

fields.label: Routes
fields.description: <base_path>/<sub_route>/<sub_category> answered by Frappe's own document API on the DocType, with OData query options ($filter, $select, $orderby, $top, $skip, $count).

name: Fraxis Settings
